name: Miguel Abreu Gallery
notes:
Site previously also listed a 36 Orchard Street space (seen in secondary sources); current site shows only 88 Eldridge as active. Treat 36 Orchard as historical unless reconfirmed. Fingerprint (2026-08-18): wordpress — /wp-json/ reachable. Wired to real live adapter (2026-08-18): the standard REST endpoints turned out to be a dead end (dozens of oddly-named, mostly-untitled "pages" from a page-builder, no clean current-show signal; the real "exhibition" custom post type isn't exposed via /wp-json/ at all). /exhibitions/ itself is a clean, well-labeled archive though (confirmed via the post-type-archive-exhibition body class) with an explicit

Current

section — scraped directly instead. Found and worked around a real markup bug on the gallery's own site: the artist-list div's class attribute is missing its "=" (renders as class"exhibition-subtitle italic"), which silently drops the class for any normal CSS-selector scrape; adapters/wordpress.ts's findByClassOrMangledAttr matches the mangled attribute name directly instead of just returning an empty artist list. Confirms "88 Eldridge" as the current space label, matching the note above.
